:::{#def-lempel-ziv-code}
#### Lempel--Ziv code

Let $x$ be a message,
and let $c(n)$ be the number of phrases in its [incremental parsing](#def-lempel-ziv-parsing).
The **Lempel--Ziv code** of $x$ writes each phrase as a pair:
the position of the earlier phrase that it extends,
with position $0$ for the empty string,
and the one new symbol.

The code writes each position in $\ceil{\log_2 c(n)}$ [bits](entropy.qmd#def-bit) of its own.
The code needs no table of phrases to decode:
a decoder that reads the pairs in order rebuilds each phrase from the earlier ones.
The decoder does need $c(n)$ to know the width of each position,
so the encoder sends $c(n)$ first.

:::
